# Fonts, served locally

The pages load these from the lab's own server instead of Google Fonts, so they look the same offline.

| Stylesheet | Used by | Font |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bricolage.css` | `play.html`, `mock-game.html` | Bricolage Grotesque (variable, weights 300–800) |
| `lab.css` | `index.html`, `pose-test-cam.html` | Inter (400–700), JetBrains Mono (400–500) |

Latin and Latin Extended only. Downloaded from Google Fonts (the source URL is at the top of each stylesheet).
All three are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1: see the `OFL-*.txt` files.
